scope.heading: 🏙 Scope
points: Development of a city-scale digital twin integrating hydrological, hydraulic, urban infrastructure, water resource, governance, and human behaviour models
Incorporates participatory governance, enabling planners and communities to co-create flood response strategies

outcomes.heading: 📈 Expected Outcomes
points: Accurate flood predictions, visualization of runoff, identification of vulnerable zones, data-driven adaptation responses
Promotes data-driven, stakeholder-collaborative flood management and planning
